package.description: WxVoice is an automated voice-back system that uses your PC's voice modem to speak the current and past weather conditions over the telephone.

en-US.description: WxVoice is an automated voice-back system that uses your PC's voice modem to speak the current and past weather conditions over the telephone.
en-US.longDescription:
WxVoice takes advantage of Text-to-Speech (TTS) technology to produce a more
natural sounding dialogue than other products that use pre-recorded numbers and
phrases.

WxVoice is an add-on product to WxSolution.

WxVoice uses the built-in Speech capabilities of Windows® 7/8.1/10.
